name: Za'tachk Interstellar Space Force
description: The Za'tachk interstellar navy — defending the polity's borders and reassuring the population. A Za'tachk career (Aliens of Charted Space Vol. 4). Commission also requires BOL 5 or lower.

crew_gunner.name: Crew/Gunner
crew_gunner.description: You are one of the crew with the basic duties required for the smooth operation of a vessel.

engineer_flight.name: Engineer/Flight
engineer_flight.description: You operate the engines or control the flight of a vessel.

stog.name: STOG
stog.description: Special Tactical Operations Group — you remotely operate drones from the safety of your vessel.

6.title: Haknux
6.bonus: SOC 10 or SOC +1, whichever is higher

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table, but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: You embarrass your CO at an important social event. Roll Diplomat 8+: succeed and you smooth it over but gain the officer as a Rival; fail and you cannot roll for promotion or commission this term and gain the officer as an Enemy.
events.4: You are given advanced training in a specialist field. Roll BOL 8+ to gain one level in any skill you already have.
events.5: A special assignment or duty on board ship. Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.
events.6: You help a superior officer in an area where their skills are lacking. Gain them as an Ally.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.8: A rival has left themselves open to a career-crippling move. Do it and ruin their life for DM+4 on your next Advancement roll; gain them as an Enemy.
events.9: You stumble across a crime on board ship. Cover it up with Deception 8+ — succeed for an extra Benefit roll, fail and you are suspected and lose your Benefit roll. Or come clean with BOL 8+ — succeed and gain the perpetrator as an Enemy plus DM+4 to your next Advancement roll, fail and the criminal escapes and you gain an Enemy. On a natural 2 on either check, take the Prisoner career next term.
events.10: Your CO takes an interest in your career. Gain Tactics (naval) 1 or DM+4 to your next Advancement roll.
events.11: Your inaction causes a collision between two spacecraft. Your next advancement or commission roll suffers DM-4.
events.12: You display great self-preservation in battle, saving the whole ship. You automatically pass your next promotion or commission roll and gain BOL +1.

mishaps.1: Severely injured (treat as a result of 2 on the Injury table). Alternatively, roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: Placed in frozen watch and revived improperly. Reduce STR, DEX or END by -1 due to muscle wastage. You are not ejected from this career.
mishaps.3: In battle, victory depends on your actions — roll 8+ with a branch skill (bridge: Electronics (sensors)/Gunner; engineering: Mechanic/Vacc Suit; STOG: Electronics (remote ops)). Fail and you are court-martialled and discharged; succeed and you are honourably discharged keeping this term's Benefit roll. On a natural 2, take the Prisoner career next term.
mishaps.4: You are blamed for an accident that kills several crew. If responsible, take one free Skills-and-Training roll before being ejected as guilt drives you to excel; if not, gain the accuser as an Enemy but keep this term's Benefit roll.
mishaps.5: A failing on your part causes a catastrophic loss aboard your ship or base. Lose BOL -1, and the only other survivor becomes your Enemy.
mishaps.6: You are wounded in the line of duty. Roll on the Injury table.
